name: Yandere: Love & Madness
summary:
Yandere: Love & Madness is a psychological thriller and action game developed by Gemora Studios. Set in a world of intrigue and obsession, the player will take on the role of a young woman with a dangerous devotion to her beloved. With mechanics inspired by the life simulation genre, the game will offer a deep narrative experience, where the player's moral choices and actions can lead to unpredictable consequences.

Through a carefully designehttps://, Yandere: Love & Madness will combine exploration, stealth, and psychological horror elements. Players must navigate the school and its surroundings, managing social relationships while struggling with the dark side of obsession. The game will offer immersive gameplay, with intense interactions, events triggered by the protagonist's behavior, and a focus on manipulation and control.

With a unique visual style and a deep narrative that explores themes of toxic love and madness, Yandere: Love & Madness will challenge players to question how far they're willing to go for love and what the line between passion and obsession truly means.
